assumptions: The app opens on the Library tab.
Back, Close, Done and left-edge swipe moves are left out.
Confirmation alerts and dialogs with no onward move are left out.
Each tap is 1. A menu item, context menu item, swipe action or VoiceOver action counts 2.
Item details, Now Playing, Timeline, Settings, Offline Storage and the export screens replace the whole tab view, so the tab bar is gone there.
Recording a Margin and Write a Margin take over the whole app until saved or cancelled.
The mini player shows on the tabs and on every full screen except Now Playing, only while a session is active.
Small parts of a screen, like rows, cards and the mini player, are counted as part of the screen that shows them.
The Margins pane inside Now Playing is part of Now Playing; the Timeline pane is drawn to the Timeline screen.
Stage changes inside Share Margins are counted under in-place menus.
Routes that exist only in DEBUG builds are left out of reachability and tap counts.
Paths from outside the app are only used for jobs that start outside the app.

jobs.name: Import an OPML file
jobs.final: Pick the .opml file, then tap Follow N.
jobs.note: Main route: Following tab, Manage feeds row, Import from another app, Choose OPML file.

jobs.name: Follow a podcast from a link
jobs.final: Paste the feed link into the feed field (long press, Paste), then tap Follow.
jobs.note: Retargeted: the Add Source link page only adds an episode or article to the Library; it has no Follow (no 'follow' in ExperienceAddSourceFlow.swift). Following by link happens on Manage feeds (Follow button, ExperienceSourcesScreen.swift:505), or from Item details' Follow button after adding (not traced). The Following tab's 'Paste a feed link' button (only when New is empty) fills the field for you.

jobs.name: Unfollow a show
jobs.final: Tap the show's Manage (…) menu, Unfollow, then confirm.
jobs.note: Shortcut when the show has an entry in Following's New list: swipe the entry left, Unfollow, confirm (3 taps on the Following tab, total 4).

jobs.name: Find the Margin you added most recently
jobs.note: Verified order: Margins are grouped by item. Items follow the order of MarginCollection's private rows, newest session date first (session updated, else created), then newest Margin (MarginCollection.swift:126). Within an item, Margins read in the order heard in the source, not newest first (ExperienceMarginsScreen.swift:390). So the newest Margin's item is usually near the top, but the Margin may not be the first row in its group.

jobs.name: Hear a Margin's moment
jobs.note: Open the Margin, then Play this moment. Long press on the row, Play this moment, costs the same.

jobs.name: Share one Margin with a friend
jobs.final: Inside Share Margins before Share 1: turn on the one Margin's Include toggle and tap Review 1. Choosing the friend in the share sheet is not counted.
jobs.note: Fastest entry is the Share button beside the item heading on the Margins tab. Add 1 if more than one Margin starts included (Select none), and 1 the first time for the 'Clean selected Margins automatically?' alert. Which Margins start included was not traced. A single Margin's own detail sheet offers only Share as Markdown.

jobs.name: See an item's details
jobs.note: Verified: the header shows title plus pills for linked episode, chapters, map scenes, Margin count and skipped tables. No published date or date added appears in ExperienceItemDetailScreen.swift; the only dates are on session rows (session updated or created date, line 659).

jobs.name: Add an article from the clipboard
jobs.final: Tap Paste at the bottom of the Add Source sheet.
jobs.note: Paste shows only on the type picker. A copied link imports and the sheet closes; the item does not open by itself (PasteAndGoBar notes).

jobs.name: Write a Margin while listening
jobs.note: Assumes a session is active so the mini player shows; otherwise start an item first.

jobs.name: Open the Timeline for what's playing
jobs.note: Assumes an active session. The pane switch shows the Timeline inside Now Playing.

jobs.name: Change the reading voice
jobs.final: In the Playback & Voice section, tap the App Voice picker and choose a voice.
jobs.note: The iOS voice picker (Speech Voice) appears below it only when App Voice is the iOS voice.

jobs.name: Free up storage
jobs.final: Tap 'Clear <size> of reproducible audio', then confirm.
jobs.note: Only clears audio the app can make again; the button shows only when there is some.

jobs.name: Export all Margins
jobs.final: Before Choose Folder: tap Select All. In Files: pick the folder. Back on Export sessions: tap Export.
jobs.note: Writes one Markdown file per session; the list defaults to sessions with Margins. Not a .spokenmargins packet. The folder is remembered, so later exports may skip the Files picker.

jobs.name: See new episodes from a show you follow
jobs.final: New entries from followed shows are rows on the Following tab; tapping one adds it to the Library and opens it.
jobs.note: Sorting and grouping of the New list were not verified.

jobs.name: Open a Margin packet a friend sent
jobs.final: Tap Import; the app then opens the item.
jobs.note: If the packet was already imported, the app opens the item directly instead of the sheet.

jobs.name: Share all of an item's Margins
jobs.final: Choosing the friend in the share sheet is not counted.
jobs.note: Margins tab, Share beside the item's heading, Share N.
